title: Character value at residue two
statement: Let $\zeta=\exp(2\pi i/3)$, and let $\chi$ be the additive character of $\mathbb Z/3\mathbb Z$ determined by $\chi(1)=\zeta$. Then $\chi(2)=\zeta^2$.
